name: Pennywise

skins.name: Neibolt
skins.lore: Inside the abandoned Neibolt house in Derry, the Losers Club confront Pennywise in one of their final battles. During the fight, Beverly attacks him with a metal rod after the group invades the creature's lair hidden beneath the old house that survived decades of tragedy and violence.

skins.name: Derry
skins.lore: This skin represents Pennywise's appearance in Welcome to Derry, the prequel series exploring the earlier massacres, disappearances, and supernatural events connected to the entity's influence over the town.

skins.name: Resting
skins.lore: At the end of Welcome to Derry, Pennywise is shown in a dormant resting state covered in blood from the head down after years of feeding and violence beneath the town before eventually awakening once again.

Set during the black-and-white events of the 1930s, this skin references the moment Bob Gray's daughter follows another child into a basement after hearing stories about a clown. When she encounters Pennywise, she calmly refers to him as 'Papa,' revealing a disturbing connection between the entity and the Gray family.

skins.name: Old School
skins.lore: This skin represents Pennywise from the 1990 IT miniseries, the classic portrayal that introduced the character to a generation of horror fans long before the modern film adaptations.

lore: Pennywise is the ancient cosmic entity from Stephen King's IT. Taking the form of a dancing clown, it feeds on fear and terrorizes the town of Derry through illusions, shapeshifting, and horrifying manifestations drawn from its victims' deepest fears.
